title.zh: 【79th Vault：运营方私钥遭获取，已提出白帽和解方案】
title.en: 【79th Vault：运营方私钥遭获取，已提出白帽和解方案】

current_state.zh: 79th Vault disclosed that a private-key compromise on Oct 7 let an attacker drain roughly $12.5M in 79AU tokens on BNB Chain, and said it has fixed the permissions, identified the attacker address, and opened a white-hat settlement negotiation the attacker has answered while pursuing asset recovery with exchanges and security firms.
